data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each Fisher02–25 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose18 and the rest10, catch=250+8k, stock left=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain; next stock may be100. Recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run income may suffer. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Each: exact intended catch, and does it depend on others?
